mapper.select: select id, gen_key, rule_version, scope_key, current_value, version, tenant_id, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time from numgen_sequence where gen_key = #{genKey} and scope_key = #{scopeKey} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into numgen_sequence (id, gen_key, rule_version, scope_key, current_value, version, tenant_id, create_time, update_time) values (#{sequence.id}, #{sequence.genKey}, #{sequence.ruleVersion}, #{sequence.scopeKey}, #{step}, 0, #{sequence.tenantId}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update rule_version = values(rule_version), current_value = current_value + values(current_value), version = version + 1, update_time = now()
